Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

3. Material 

Stainless ueel conforming ro Designation 04CH9Ni9 or L)7Cn9Ni9 ol Schedule V of IS • 1570-1961*, 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 Specula shall be of one piece construction fr^e from p(LS and other surface flaws 

4.2 Ail edges shall be even, rounckd and not s.harp 

4.3 On closure, the blades shall come in contacc with each other starting from the tips of the blades and 
progressing along the edges towards the bases of the blades While edges near the bases are in contact, 
the tips shall not gape. On release, the prongs shall return to their original positions. 

4.4 The speculum shall be" finished dull. 



'Schedules for wrought Kaeli for general engineering purposes.

5. Test 

5.1 toad Closure Test — Apply a force at the point where the blade ends to make the tips of the blades 
Just touch. The force required shall be as follows: 

Sixt No. Loflrf 

N 
■±0-2 N ( ± 20 gf approximately > 

I to 3 f-5 ( ISO gf > 

4 to 7 25 ( 250 gf ) 

5.2 Corros/on Resistance — Scrub the sample with soap and warm water, rinse In hot water and then dip In 
95 percent ethyl alcohol. Dry the sample, Immerse In copper sulphate solution at room temperature for 
6 minutes and wash off with fresh water or wet cotton wool. Make up the solution as follows: 

Copper sulphate ( CuSO r 5H,0) 4-0 g 

Sulphuric acid ( H a S0 4 ) ( sp gr 1-84 ) 10-0 g 

Water ( H.O ) 90*0 ml 

No red stains or spots on the sample shall be allowed but dulling of the polished surface may be 
permitted. 

6. Marking — Mark with the following: 

a) Manufacturer's name or Initials or recognized trade-mark, 

b) Words ' stainless steel \ and 
c} Size of the speculum- 

6.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details aviafable from the Indian Standard* Institution, New Delhi. 

7. Packing — Speculum shall be wrapped In moisture-proof paper and packed In cardboard cartons.
